title: Blastback Engine Documentation
description: Official documentation for the Blastback Engine — a 2D game engine with Lua scripting for modders and developers.
content:
Blastback Engine

Comprehensive Lua scripting documentation for modders and developers. Build entities, craft AI behaviors, design weapons, and bring your 2D worlds to life.

Get StartedAPI Reference

Explore the Documentation

🚀
Getting Started
Learn the fundamentals of the Blastback Engine, project structure, entity definitions, and core concepts.
🎭
Entity System
Understand how entities are defined, spawned, and managed. Explore JSON definitions and lifecycle events.
🧩
Components
Dive into the full library of built-in components — animation, health, weapons, UI, and more.
📐
Models
Reference for data models: WeaponModel, ProjectileModel, DropModel, VisualModel, and others.
🧠
AI System
Master behavior trees to create intelligent enemies, NPCs, and autonomous entity behaviors.
📖
Scripting Guide
Step-by-step tutorials covering entity scripting, events, commands, physics, and best practices.
